NHRC is a statutory body, NOT constitutional.

items: Exams often trick candidates into marking NHRC as a constitutional body instead of a statutory body.
NHRC's recommendations are purely advisory and non-binding.
NHRC has powers of a civil court, not a criminal court.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NHRC is a statutory body established in 1993, not a constitutional body.
The recommendations made by the NHRC are advisory in nature.
The Chairperson of the commission is usually a former Chief Justice of India (CJI).
The commission possesses the powers of a civil court.
